verdict.rationale: Lambda's Cloud API (REST, OpenAPI-documented) lets users launch/manage instances, choose base images, and inject cloud-init config programmatically, and a third-party built a CLI/MCP server on top of it, showing real API usability for AI-native workflows. However, key UI-only features—firewall rule management, usage/billing dashboards, filesystem creation, and 1-Click Cluster/Slurm/Kubernetes provisioning—are not shown to have documented API equivalents, and the docs.lambda.ai OpenAPI probe returned 404s. Missing for 10: documented API parity for firewall rules, filesystem management, usage page, and cluster/Slurm/K8s provisioning; independent confirmation the OpenAPI spec covers all UI actions.
